# Concept Agency

> A curated B2B agency in Norway that brings a small number of design-led, international brands to the Nordic market — placing them in concept stores, museum shops, and optician practices.

## What we do

Concept Agency selects a small number of design-led brands and builds them lasting homes in the Nordics. We are commission-based: we don't manufacture, we represent brand owners and manage their retailer, optician, and insurance partner networks across Norway and the wider Nordic region. We say no more often than we say yes — a brand joins our portfolio only when we believe it deserves a permanent place on Nordic shelves.

## Brands we represent

- **Izipizi** (France) — eyewear (reading glasses, sunglasses, screen glasses) for lifestyle retailers and opticians. We are the Izipizi Global Agent of the Year (2026), and the #1 Izipizi agent worldwide. The Izipizi RX collection — an optician-only line for myopia management — is arriving in 2027.
- **Hippie de Luxe** (Sweden, formerly Ohlsson & Löhåven) — the Nordics' leading gift article house, spanning 33 brands.
- **Nychair X** (Japan) — the iconic Japanese folding lounge chair designed by Takeshi Nii in 1970, still made entirely in Japan. New to the portfolio in 2026, for design stores, museum shops, and interiors retailers.
- **Dana Wyse** (Paris / Vancouver) — limited-edition concept art.
- **Milena Kling** (Berlin, Germany) — Studio Milena Kling: contemporary mouth-blown glass, signed and one of a kind. Work is held in the permanent collection of the Pinakothek der Moderne and used at Maaemo in Oslo. For museum and gallery shops, design retail, interiors and fine dining.
- **Eyewear Insurance** — aftercare insurance programmes for optician practices in Norway.

## Who we work with

- For Retail: lifestyle and design retailers, concept stores, and museum shops across the Nordics
- For Opticians: optical retailers in Norway, offering eyewear lines, insurance aftercare programmes, and the Izipizi RX collection for myopia management arriving in 2027
- 200 doors across Norway: concept stores, museum shops, lifestyle retailers and more than 50 optician practices

## Concept Agency Consulting

Alongside the agency, Concept Agency Consulting works with owner-led small and mid-sized companies (typically 5 to 50 people) and professional services firms. The lead offer is Fractional COO and AI operations: Erik Spade steps in as part-time COO, connects the systems the company already runs, and puts AI on top. Engagement models: AI sprint (2–4 weeks, diagnostic and prioritised roadmap), Fractional COO and AI operations (retainer), growth strategy project, and AI search visibility audit. Concept Agency itself runs on an AI-native stack and uses the method on itself first.

- English: https://conceptagency.no/consulting
- Norwegian (KI-rådgivning, innleid COO): https://conceptagency.no/raadgivning

## Who runs it

Concept Agency is led personally by Erik Spade, Managing Partner, with three decades of experience building brands and businesses in the Nordics. Every account is handled by the person who signed it.
